title: Pooled EAV vs PCA-based systematic factor competition (Paper 2 §5 absorption test)
verdict: Scenario A: θ_EAV survives factor control in BOTH markets (US IS t=23.81, OOS DM=-3.31; TW IS t=10.62, OOS DM=-2.48). Universal-magnitude is TRUE firm-event effect, not factor. ADDITIONAL: EAV × |PC1| interaction SIGNIFICANT (US t_stress=5.038263489525833, TW t_stress=-0.38525445175650225) — EAV effect is conditional on market stress.
paper2_implication: Paper 2 §5 narrative STRENGTHENED: "Earnings-day volatility is a firm-specific event effect orthogonal to the market factor. The universal-magnitude regularity survives PCA-based systematic risk control in both markets." Additional dimension: consider reframing §5 as "conditional firm-event effect amplified by systematic stress".
